question: Employees who use the company gym take fewer sick days. Should the company expand the gym?
options: Not on this evidence: healthy people use gyms
Only if the gym is free
answer: Nobody assigned people to the gym; they chose. Whatever makes someone a gym user — health, age, energy, a job with slack in it — also affects sick days. The gym could do nothing and the figures would look the same.
move: When people chose their own group, the groups differ before you do anything.
trap: Reading a difference between two self-selected groups as an effect.
